findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "compare_properties" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_properties, prepare_findestate_viewing, render_findestate_properties, open_findestate_enquiry · Private data: search_properties, get_property, get_auction, search_findestate_properties, get_findestate_property, compare_properties, prepare_findestate_viewing, render_findestate_properties, open_findestate_enquiry, prepare_findestate_enquiry, submit_findestate_enquiry · Public sink: prepare_findestate_viewing, render_findestate_properties, open_findestate_enquiry, prepare_findestate_enquiry, submit_findestate_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_properties, prepare_findestate_viewing, render_findestate_properties, open_findestate_enquiry · Private data: search_properties, get_property, get_auction, search_findestate_properties, get_findestate_property, compare_properties, prepare_findestate_viewing, render_findestate_properties, open_findestate_enquiry, prepare_findestate_enquiry, submit_findestate_enquiry · Public sink: prepare_findestate_viewing, render_findestate_properties, open_findestate_enquiry, prepare_findestate_enquiry, submit_findestate_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
